# Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing — Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API & Omnichannel Marketing

> Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing is an enterprise Omnichannel Marketing and WhatsApp Commerce platform built on the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0), AWS SES High-Deliverability Email, and DLT Bulk SMS gateways. It offers 0% platform commission on WhatsApp messages, direct Meta billing with 100% GST Input Tax Credit (ITC), interactive product carousels, Click-to-WhatsApp Ads lead capture, and a unified multi-agent shared team inbox.

## Platform Overview
- **Product Name**: Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing
- **Official Website**: https://marketing.inspenox.in/
- **Parent Organization**: Inspenox (https://inspenox.in)
- **Primary Audience**: E-commerce brands, retail stores, educational institutes, real estate agencies, healthcare providers, and high-growth businesses running sales and marketing campaigns on WhatsApp.
- **Key Differentiator**: 0% platform markup on WhatsApp conversations. Businesses pay Meta directly with zero locked prepaid wallets, itemized template analytics, and 100% claimable GST tax invoices.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0) Limitless Broadcasting
- **Zero Ban Risk**: Uses official Meta Graph API v20.0 endpoints approved by Meta, eliminating ban risks associated with unofficial automation tools.
- **Interactive Multimedia Carousels**: Showcase products inside WhatsApp with 10-card horizontal carousels, customizable "Buy Now" CTA buttons, and coupon codes.
- **Dynamic Template Personalization**: Personalize messages with dynamic variables (`{{customer_name}}`, `{{order_id}}`, `{{custom_field}}`), header media (images, PDFs, videos), and quick-reply action chips.
- **Live Funnel Analytics**: Real-time tracking of Sent (100%), Delivered (97%+), Read (93%+), and Click-Through Rates (up to 45% CTR).
- **Automated Scheduling & Segmentation**: Schedule campaigns for festivals, flash sales, and specific audience tags (e.g. VIP Spenders, Repeat Buyers).

### 2. Conversational Click-to-WhatsApp Ads (Meta Ads Direct Handoff)
- **Zero Drop-Off Lead Capture**: Direct Facebook and Instagram ad traffic straight into WhatsApp conversations, capturing verified phone numbers with zero landing page form friction.
- **24/7 Automated Qualification Flows**: Instant greeting auto-responders that qualify buyer budget, timeline, and product preferences before routing to sales agents.
- **4.8X Higher ROAS**: Significantly higher conversion rates compared to traditional web lead forms.

### 3. Unified Multi-Agent Shared Team Inbox
- **Single Number Multi-Agent Support**: Connect multiple team members to manage conversations from one verified WhatsApp business number.
- **WhatsApp-Style Color Tags & Labels**: Categorize leads with customized color tags (`Repeat Buyers`, `High Spenders`, `Hot Lead`, `Payment Pending`, `Order Placed`).
- **24-Hour Service Window Tracker**: Real-time countdown timer badges (`24h Active Free Tier` vs `24h Window Expired`) to maximize Meta's free customer service window.
- **Live Verified Read Receipts**: Real-time double blue checkmarks (✓✓) synchronized via official Meta webhooks.
- **Enterprise Number Masking Shield**: Masks sensitive customer phone numbers (`+91 •••••`) for agent role permissions to prevent database leaks.

### 4. Omnichannel Marketing Suite
- **WhatsApp Cloud API**: Broadcasts, transactional OTPs, order notifications, and two-way conversations.
- **Bulk Email Engine**: High-inbox deliverability powered by AWS SES (₹0.05 / email) for newsletters, receipts, and multi-touch drips.
- **DLT Bulk SMS Gateway**: Regulatory-compliant instant SMS dispatch (₹0.25 / SMS) for critical alerts, payment links, and emergency fallback.

### Plan Features Breakdown

- **Growth (₹2,499/mo)**: Up to 3 WhatsApp Numbers, 15,000 contacts, personalized name/order variables, collaborative team inbox, 5 dashboard seats, full open/read/click analytics, priority sending speed, priority chat & phone support.
- **Business Pro (₹5,999/mo)**: Unlimited WhatsApp Numbers, unlimited contacts, multi-brand dashboard, unlimited team seats with RBAC, maximum dispatch speed, dedicated 24/7 account manager, custom bespoke integrations.

## Official Pay-As-You-Go Message Rates (0% Platform Markup)

Inspenox adds **₹0.00 platform commission** to your messaging costs. You pay WhatsApp's exact official base prices:

- **WhatsApp Marketing / Promotional Message**: ₹0.8631 / delivered message (vs ₹1.00 – ₹1.25 on marked-up platforms).
- **WhatsApp Utility / Order Updates / OTP**: ₹0.1150 / delivered message (vs ₹0.18 – ₹0.30 on marked-up platforms).
- **WhatsApp Service / Inbound Customer Window**: Free 24-hour service conversation window.
- **Bulk Email Broadcast (AWS SES)**: ₹0.0500 / email sent.
- **DLT Compliant SMS Broadcast**: ₹0.2500 / SMS sent.

## Technical Architecture & Compliance
- **Direct Meta Integration**: Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v20.0 client endpoints.
- **Data Security & Privacy**: Customer databases and broadcast contact lists are protected with token encryption and phone number masking.
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: Cloudflare Pages / Workers global edge hosting with enterprise AWS SES email routing.
- **Regulatory Compliance**: Full DLT compliance for India SMS telecommunications and strict adherence to WhatsApp Business Messaging Policies.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Do I need to pay extra for sending messages?
No. Your monthly subscription covers platform access, shared inbox, broadcast tooling, and analytics. For delivered WhatsApp messages, you only pay Meta's official base rate (₹0.8631 marketing, ₹0.1150 utility). Inspenox charges zero commission.

### Can I change or cancel my plan anytime?
Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your billing dashboard. There are no lock-in contracts. If you cancel, your account remains active until the end of your billing cycle.

### Is setup difficult for non-technical users?
Not at all. Inspenox provides an intuitive onboarding wizard to connect your WhatsApp Business number in under 15 minutes. Support is readily available via live chat and call.

### Will my WhatsApp number get banned?
No. Inspenox operates exclusively through the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, the exact infrastructure trusted by enterprise brands like Flipkart and Zomato. Unofficial scrapers and unauthorized bots that cause bans are never used.

### What messages can I send?
You can send promotional discount offers, festive campaigns, interactive product carousels with buttons, transactional receipts, delivery tracking alerts, authentication OTPs, and customer support replies.

### Can multiple team members use the dashboard?
Yes. The Growth plan includes 5 team members, and Business Pro provides unlimited team seats with custom role assignments.
